log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed national-1 and regional-1 (quick, morning). Strategy: start low-profile, watch the day-3 press conference pool. I am Kita, night worker (free morning/afternoon), follow regional, web, court, foreign, medical, union. Kills reveal the sources I follow if L traces them; the timing risk is lowest with quick entries in free blocks.

National kills reveal nothing about my sources. Source-only kills may let L trace me if he can trace that source. Wait for the day-3 press conference before killing more source-only victims. Quick entries only in morning/afternoon.
